rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for an ATM.

example.english: I’ll go to the cashpoint to withdraw money first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 tai4 fun2 gei1 gam6 cin2 sin1

rows.note: A speaker picks this colloquial term when stressing that the machine is used to take out money.

example.english: This cashpoint is broken, let’s go to another one.
example.traditional: 呢部撳錢機壞咗，去第二部啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gam6 cin2 gei1 waai6 zo2 heoi3 dai6 ji6 bou6 laa1

rows.note: This is the formal or official term, especially in written contexts and bank announcements.

example.english: The bank notice says the cashpoint will be out of service tonight.
example.traditional: 銀行通知話自動櫃員機今晚會停用。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 tung1 zi1 waa6 zi6 dung6 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 gam1 maan5 wui5 ting4 jung6
